narrative.overview: The whole game is one dark dubbing booth after hours. A wall of charcoal egg-crate foam surrounds a picture monitor, and under it runs the rhythmo band: an ivory celluloid strip that scrolls the characters' lines toward a red sync bar. Everything else is the gear you would find in that room: an ON AIR lamp, a needle VU meter, matte rubber transport keys, desk faders, and masking-tape labels written in marker. It is built for a sofa audience watching one TV, so scale is generous and each screen has one obvious action. Light comes only from things that really emit it (the lamp, the LEDs, the monitor); every other surface is matte.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, matte booth ground with real emissive light sources only
The rhythmo band is the signature component; time runs right to left, matching Arabic reading
Every player owns one wax-pencil color for the whole night
Handwriting (Marhey) is reserved for things written by hand: tape labels, band lines, cue sheets

rules.name: The Real Light Rule
rules.body: Glow is allowed only on things that emit light: the ON AIR lamp, LEDs, and the recording monitor outline. Keys, panels and paper never glow.

rules.name: The One Color Per Player Rule
rules.body: A player's wax color is the only color that identifies them, everywhere. Never color a player by rank or state.

rules.name: The Hand-Written Rule
rules.body: Marhey appears only where a person would have written with a marker: tape, band, cue sheets. Never on keys, labels or headings.

rules.name: The Tabular Counter Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes (take, scores, average, clip count) sits in a dark counter well with tabular digits and rolls digit by digit when it changes.

rules.name: The Matte Rubber Rule
rules.body: Keys are a single flat tone with a soft drop shadow. No gradients imitating plastic or chrome.

dos: Do give each screen exactly one big key, in Record Red or Go Yellow.
Do keep every time axis running right to left.
Do roll every changing number in a counter well.
Do keep a player's wax color identical on every screen.
donts: Don't add glow to anything that is not a light source.
Don't use Marhey for UI labels, headings or keys.
Don't use typed glyphs or emoji as icons; icons are drawn SVG with a 2px round stroke.
Don't fake plastic or metal with gradient bevels.
Don't add a small label above a heading (eyebrow); the heading speaks for itself.
